meta.source: highlevel-requirements.md (4 Oct 2026). Built from scratch; 1px here = 1dp (sizes) or 1sp (text) on Android.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Colour 1 of 4. The page behind everything; also the label colour on `accent` and the colour of buttons that sit on a `fill` area.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Colour 2 of 4. Every flat shape that is not the main action: secondary buttons, list tiles, cards, the Now Playing bar, search field, song-picture placeholders, the selected tab. No borders: the fill is the shape.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Colour 3 of 4. All text and icons on `surface` and `fill` (14:1 and 12:1 or more). Hierarchy comes from size and weight, never from a lighter grey.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Colour 4 of 4. A warm mid brown for the one main action on a screen (main button, Play / Pause disc), the current choice in a group (sort, Text Size, Shuffle On) and the seek bar. Labels on it are `on-accent`. As text it is allowed on `surface` only (7.5:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon on an `accent` fill: the same colour as `surface` (7.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 3dp focus outline, 3dp clear of the control. Same as `ink`.

tokens.name: press-overlay
tokens.usage: `ink` at low opacity laid over a button while a finger is down (Compose ripple). Not a fifth colour.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: `ink` at opacity behind a confirm dialog. Not a fifth colour.

tokens.name: drawing-ink
tokens.usage: Lines of the photo drawing and the music-note logo: the same as `ink`.

tokens.name: drawing-paper
tokens.usage: Paper of the photo drawing and the logo: the same as `surface`. 14:1 with `drawing-ink`.

styles.name: song-hero
styles.usage: Song title on the Song screen and Now Playing. Centred, wraps as needed.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The personalised app title and every screen title. Wraps to 2 lines, never shortened.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings, dialog questions, card headlines.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, messages, artist and status lines. The smallest running text in the app.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Song titles in rows, setting names.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Seek bar times and lengths. Tabular figures.

styles.name: button-hero
styles.usage: The one 96dp main button on Home and Add Song.

styles.name: control-label
styles.usage: Label under an icon in stacked buttons: tabs, Settings, Previous / Pause / Next, row Play. The smallest text in the app, always paired with a 28dp+ icon.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its own status word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and the line under it; between song rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a button; avatar to title.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin; the minimum gap between two touch targets; card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button side padding; between groups on a screen; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Around the big picture on the Song and Now Playing screens.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Song pictures in rows, cards and the bar; tick boxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, list tiles, cards, settings rows, search field, choice rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The 96dp main button, dialogs, the big song picture.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Round things only: Play / Pause disc, avatar, sort choices.

size.note: Fixed sizes in dp. Touch targets never shrink with Text Size; they only grow.

tokens.name: size-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable.

tokens.name: size-play
tokens.usage: The Play / Pause disc and the main button on Home and Add Song.

tokens.name: size-transport
tokens.usage: Previous and Next discs on Now Playing.

tokens.name: size-avatar
tokens.usage: Photo drawing (or music-note logo) in the title bar.

tokens.name: size-art-row
tokens.usage: Song picture in a song row and the Now Playing bar.

tokens.name: size-art-hero
tokens.usage: Song picture on the Song and Now Playing screens; photo drawing preview.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons and rows.

tokens.name: size-icon-lg
tokens.usage: Icons in the main button, transport discs and list tiles.

tokens.name: size-handle
tokens.usage: Seek and volume handle; the whole 64dp row around it is touchable.

tokens.name: size-track
tokens.usage: Seek and volume track thickness.

tokens.name: size-tile
tokens.usage: Minimum height of a list tile on Home.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

textScale.note: Settings → Text Size. Multiplies on top of the phone's own font scale; the product is capped at 2.

tokens.name: text-normal
tokens.usage: Text Size: Normal.

tokens.name: text-large
tokens.usage: Text Size: Large.

tokens.name: text-extra-large
tokens.usage: Text Size: Extra Large.

tokens.name: text-cap
tokens.usage: Maximum of phone scale × app scale.
